design.controls: Original six financial controls; add full benchmark, size/debt and review-volume controls separately; hold full-control sample fixed in a companion fit.
design.influence: Leave each of the original candidate companies, industries and years out in turn. Report every omission and full ranges, with no deletion selected for significance.
design.resampling: 1,999 restricted-null company wild-bootstrap draws for each original coefficient; 2,000 company bootstrap draws for original baseline, interaction and marginal slopes; fixed seeds.
design.multiplicity: Report nominal intervals and p-values. Adjust over the entire fixed robustness menu, then append every new paired-pattern test to all 1,408 prior paired comparisons, and new individual tests to the full prior coefficient families. Earlier model selection is not erased by this follow-up.
design.proxy_audit: Rebuild capped rounds from original deduplicated reviews. Compare total-round growth, average rounds per reporting review, and review-count growth. Missing rounds remain missing for coverage checks; do not invent hires or vacancies.
design.minimum: At least 80 observations and 30 companies for planned fits; company clustered errors except explicitly two-way model.
design.reporting: Keep all earlier results; publish aggregate estimates only, no source narratives or omitted-company identifiers.

zero_rounds_amendment.Reason: Source-prompt review found no explicit missing-versus-zero convention for the integer rounds field. There are 21,701 zero-coded deduplicated review records.
Checks: Treat zero round counts as unavailable and require at least 80 percent positive round coverage in both activity years.
Use average positive reported rounds under the same coverage requirement.
